title: Video Killed the Radio Star
headline: Trevor Horn kept telling his engineer 'It's not happening'
caption:
"Loud without cutting your head off." That's how Gary Langan described what he was after with Trevor Horn's vocal on this song.

The voice was meant to sound like an early broadcast, so they ran it through a Vox AC30 amp for that telephone effect, limiting its bandwidth at first. They tried a bullhorn as well and found it too harsh. Afterwards Langan compressed and EQ'd the vocal, and he said doing the compression for old-style parts was a "real skill".

🎧 The song: "Video Killed the Radio Star" by The Buggles

Source: Gary Langan's recollections (via Wikipedia)
